name: Jingle Bell Jam
paras: Greeley Parks and Recreation hosts Jingle Bell Jam at the Family FunPlex, 1501 65th Avenue, on Friday, December 18, 2026, from 5 to 8 PM. Admission is free.
Families can visit with Santa and Mrs. Claus, sip hot cocoa and decorate an ornament.
tip: Plan to decorate an ornament and visit Santa and Mrs. Claus before the 8 PM close.

name: Skate With Santa at the Greeley Ice Haus
paras: Santa takes to the rink on Saturday, December 19, 2026, when the Greeley Ice Haus at 900 8th Avenue runs its Skate With Santa session from noon to 1:30 PM. One $15 ticket covers admission and rental skates, so there is nothing extra to book.
The city's listing promises a free skating lesson alongside hot cocoa, face painting and crafts. Kids can have their picture taken with Santa, and the Zamboni is part of the fun.
tip: Arrive at noon so the skating lesson fits in before the lines for Santa pictures build.

name: Homesteader's Holiday at Centennial Village Museum
cost: Adults $8, youth 7 to 17 and seniors $6, children 6 and under free, family of 3 to 5 $20
paras: Greeley's Centennial Village Museum decks its historical homes and pathways for Homesteader's Holiday on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 12 to 6 PM at 1475 A Street. Adults pay $8, youth ages 7 to 17 and seniors pay $6, children 6 and under are free, and a family of 3 to 5 pays $20. Visitors with demonstrated need (SNAP or EBT) enter free.
The day offers holiday crafts and music, old-fashioned candle dipping and festive historical homes. A visit with Cowboy Santa is part of the museum's holiday weekend listing on Visit Greeley.
tip: Start with candle dipping and crafts, then tour the historical homes while the lights come on.
